mutations.M3_strip_removed_from_finalizeAssistantM: caught by the unit case only. On the mounted page it is an equivalent mutant: the delta handler already re-strips the whole accumulation on every chunk, so the finalizer's strip finds nothing left to remove over every chunking tried (whole fence, split tag, split JSON, unterminated last line, fence only).
mutations.M4_both_strips_removed: caught by the unit case and both rendered cases
mutations.M5_finalizer_keeps_streamStatus: caught by the rendered fence-only completion case

defectFoundNotFixed.summary: When a chunk boundary falls inside the follow-up JSON, the delta handler strips the unclosed opener and the tail of the payload (for example `change this view?"] ```) stays in the visible answer. The finalizer does not catch it because the opener is already gone. Reproduced on the mounted page on base; not fixed here because this item changes no product file.

suites.rationale: Rewritten. The case that read AdvisoryIntelligencePage.tsx for the substring '? finalizeAssistantMessage(m)' is deleted, not sharpened, along with the file read. Two rendered cases replace it: the page is mounted, a starter prompt is clicked, and a controlled /api/intelligence/ask stream is released chunk by chunk with no agent-answer packet. One asserts the follow-up fence never shows, read once while the stream is still open and once after it closes; the other asserts a fence-only answer does not leave the last progress status standing as the finished answer. The three unit cases are unchanged. Five mutations run; all five caught, and M3 is caught only by the unit case because it is equivalent on the mounted page (see mutations).
